result.summary: The pedestrian environment features wide, well-maintained sidewalks in a dense urban commercial district. However, the lack of marked crosswalks at the immediate intersection and the wide, multi-lane roadway create significant exposure and risk for pedestrians crossing the street.

hazards.name: Unmarked crossing
hazards.description: There are no marked crosswalks at the foreground intersection, leaving pedestrians without a designated path across a wide multi-lane street.

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: The width of the roadway creates a long unprotected crossing distance, increasing pedestrian exposure to vehicle traffic.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility continental crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions (bulb-outs) to shorten the crossing distance and improve sight lines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a median refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide street in two stages.

result.summary: The image shows a wide urban intersection in a mixed-use commercial area with visible pedestrian and cyclist activity. Despite the presence of traffic lights, the environment lacks basic pedestrian safety infrastructure such as marked crosswalks and dedicated pedestrian signals.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: The intersection lacks any painted crosswalks, providing no visual cue to drivers to expect pedestrians.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide expanse of the roadway increases the time pedestrians are exposed to vehicle traffic.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No pedestrian-specific signal heads are visible, requiring pedestrians to interpret vehicle signals for crossing.
